meta.title: 卧蚕天才养成记！从0开始画妈生感卧蚕！
meta.title_en: Aegyo-sal Genius Guide: Natural Under-Eye Dimensionality from Scratch

scenes.title_cn: 第一关：你在眼下画了一条线，又在上方…
scenes.title_en: Level one: you draw a line under the eye a…
scenes.context: 从阴影线进阶到阴影面。
sentences: 你在眼下画了一条线，又在上方提亮，恭喜你掌握了画卧蚕的关键方法。
You draw a line under the eye and highlight above—congrats, that's the key aegyo-sal method.
aegyo-sal（卧蚕）
可以把深色阴影线换成浅色阴影面。
Swap the dark shadow line for a soft shadow plane.
shadow plane（阴影面）
scenes.speak: You draw a line under the eye and highlight above—congrats, that's the key aegyo-sal method. Swap the dark shadow line for a soft shadow plane.

scenes.title_cn: 进阶：你换了把有点厚度的小刷子，沾取…
scenes.title_en: Leveling up: you switch to a slightly thic…
scenes.context: 小刷+晕染+渐变成就自然立体。
sentences: 你换了把有点厚度的小刷子，沾取棕色，先擦掉了余粉，再晕染开。
You switch to a thicker brush, pick up brown, tap off the excess, and blend.
tap off excess（擦掉余粉）
因为你知道越靠外面你的颜色要越淡。
Because you know the color must fade as it goes outward.
fade outward（向外变淡）
果然卧蚕线变得又柔和又立体。
Sure enough, the line becomes soft and dimensional.
soft and dimensional（柔和立体）
scenes.speak: You switch to a thicker brush, pick up brown, tap off the excess, and blend. Because you know the color must fade as it goes outward. Sure enough, the line becomes soft and dimensional.

scenes.title_cn: 第三关：观察仔细的你发现卧蚕像是挂在…
scenes.title_en: Level three: observant you notices the aeg…
scenes.context: 上下加深让卧蚕与眼融为一体。
sentences: 卧蚕像是挂在脸上的，和眼睛脱节不够和谐。
The aegyo-sal looks stuck on, disconnected from the eye.
disconnected（脱节）
既然鼻影要左右加深更立体，那卧蚕是不是也要上下加深呢？
If nose shadow deepens left and right for depth, shouldn't aegyo-sal deepen up and down too?
deepen up and down（上下加深）
用眼影加深卧蚕上方的睫毛根部、下睑三角区，填补眼尾空缺。
Deepen the lash root above, the lower-lid triangle, and fill the outer-corner gap.
lower-lid triangle（下睑三角区）
果然换了之后，卧蚕和整个眼睛都连接在了一起，更和谐了。
Now the aegyo-sal and the whole eye connect together—more harmonious.
connect together（连成一体）
paraphrase: deepen up and down（上下加深
deepen up and down（上下加深
scenes.speak: The aegyo-sal looks stuck on, disconnected from the eye. If nose shadow deepens left and right for depth, shouldn't aegyo-sal deepen up and down too? Deepen the lash root above, the lower-lid triangle, and fill the outer-corner gap. Now the aegyo-sal and the whole eye connect together—more harmonious.

scenes.title_cn: 第四关：追求极致的你觉得还不够，又想…
scenes.title_en: Level four: chasing perfection, you recall…
scenes.context: 小范围提亮+哑光叠加增加层次与持久。
sentences: 你又想到球体的高光点都是小面积点缀。
You recall highlights on a sphere are small accents.
small accents（小面积点缀）
在卧蚕的前端上方小范围提亮，到中间自然过渡消失。
Brighten a small area at the front-top, fading naturally by the middle.
natural fade（自然过渡）
果然卧蚕瞬间变得非常立体了。
The aegyo-sal instantly becomes very dimensional.
instantly dimensional（瞬间立体）
你又用哑光高光叠加了一遍，高光粉结合就非常牢固，更持久了。
You layer matte highlighter—it binds firmly and lasts longer.
lasts longer（更持久）
scenes.speak: You recall highlights on a sphere are small accents. Brighten a small area at the front-top, fading naturally by the middle. The aegyo-sal instantly becomes very dimensional. You layer matte highlighter—it binds firmly and lasts longer.

scenes.title_cn: 结尾：恭喜你，这样超简单就能画出妈生…
sentences: 这样超简单就能画出妈生感卧蚕的技巧就被你给发现了。
You've discovered the super simple natural aegyo-sal technique.
natural aegyo-sal（妈生感卧蚕）
我就说你是个天才吧，还有什么是你做不到的？
I told you you're a genius—what can't you do?
you're a genius（你是天才）
scenes.speak: You've discovered the super simple natural aegyo-sal technique. I told you you're a genius—what can't you do?

practice: Draw a line under the eye and highlight above.
Swap the dark line for a soft shadow plane.
Deepen the lash root and lower-lid triangle.
Brighten a small front-top area and let it fade.
pitfalls: Draw one hard line under the eye.
Use a soft shadow plane with a blended fade.
卧蚕从阴影线进阶到阴影面更自然。
Fade the color as it goes outward.
Connect it with the lash root and lower-lid triangle.
上下加深让卧蚕与眼睛连成一体。
Brighten a small area and fade by the middle.
高光小面积点缀、中间自然过渡。
Layer matte highlighter so it lasts longer.
shifts: 说卧蚕只会说 eyebag line
用 aegyo-sal（卧蚕）、shadow plane（阴影面）、lash root（睫毛根部）
用 blend（晕染）、tap off excess（擦余粉）、fade outward（向外渐淡）
用 dimensional（立体）、harmonious（和谐）、natural born look（妈生感）
footer_notes: 转录基于图文实录完整口播。已校正：眼下画线上方提亮、深色阴影线换浅色阴影面、小刷子、擦余粉、晕染、越靠外越淡、鼻影上下加深、睫毛根部、下睑三角区、眼尾空缺、球体高光、前端上方提亮、哑光高光叠加、妈生感卧蚕等。
